I couldn't find a name for Driftmoor's night dispatcher. The only record I have says engineering provided a manual CSV patch "for the night dispatcher" at Driftmoor Marine Freight. It gives no name or email.

The night dispatcher named Hector, at the Beaumont barge slip, belongs to Pellucid Harbor Logistics. That's a different account, so I wouldn't use him.

Kwame owns Driftmoor, so he's the best person to ask. I haven't invented an address. If the note goes to anyone outside pemberline.com, Ruth Calloway needs to approve it, even as a draft.
